hooks._comment: On Windows 'python3' is the Microsoft Store alias: it exists in PATH, prints a warning and exits 49 without running anything. The probe picks the first interpreter that actually starts.
hooks.command: bash -c 'for p in python3 python py; do "$p" -c "" >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec "$p" "$1"; done; exit 0' _ "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/log-session.py"
